starbridge ask \
  --question 'Purge trash after how many days?' \
  --context 'Trash never purges and storage doubled. 85% of restore requests come within 3 weeks of the delete; each month of trash kept costs about $20/month.

**30 days:** covers the 3-week window with margin; about $20/month.
**90 days:** widest restore window; about $60/month.' \
  --option '7 days' --option '30 days' --option '90 days' --recommended '30 days' \
  --waiting
